title: Sample Connector settings
description: Operator settings for the reference plugin. Rendered entirely by the shared schema-driven form engine (TITAN-FRT-035) — there is no hand-built form for this or any other plugin.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Which remote workspace this connector syncs with.

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: Personal access token for api.example.com. Stored encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM, SEC-063) and never returned by any endpoint.

sync_interval_minutes.title: Sync interval
sync_interval_minutes.description: How often to poll for changes, in minutes.
